# Outcome sub-dossier — Education Realty Trust business, realized record ~3-5 years after closing (~2018)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the registrant terminated its SEC
> reporting obligations shortly after closing, there is no subsequent 10-K filed by
> the registrant itself; the sub-dossier below traces what public record, if any,
> exists for the surviving business through the fixed ~2021-2023 outcome window. This
> sub-dossier contains no information about how the transaction was structured at
> closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- The registrant (filing under its prior name, Education Realty Trust, Inc., noted as
  succeeded by merger) filed a Form 15 on October 2, 2018, certifying and giving
  notice of termination of registration / suspension of its duty to file reports
  under Sections 12(g), 13, and 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, listing
  "Approximate number of holders of record as of the certification or notice date:
  One." [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-039924, Form 15-12B]
- The registrant's EDGAR filing history under CIK 0001302343 shows no Form 10-K,
  10-Q, or 20-F filed after that Form 15-12B; its last annual report (Form 10-K)
  covered fiscal year 2017 and was filed February 27, 2018, before the mergers
  closed. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001302343&type=10-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]
- Consequently, no audited public financial statements exist for the surviving
  collegiate-housing business for the ~2021-2023 outcome window under this
  registrant.

## Check of a separately reporting joint-venture participant
- A portion of the underlying real estate came under the ownership of a joint-venture
  vehicle in which an affiliate of Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. ("BREIT"),
  a public non-traded REIT that files periodic reports with the SEC, holds the
  majority interest. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-038813, Form 8-K, Item 2.01]
- BREIT's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021 (filed within the ~2021-2023 outcome window)
  was reviewed; it contains no segment-level, property-level, or portfolio-level
  financial disclosure specific to that student-housing real estate — the term
  "Education Realty" does not appear anywhere in the filing. No separately disclosed
  post-close trajectory for that piece of the business is available through this
  avenue either. [SRC: SEC accession 0001662972-22-000027, Form 10-K (fiscal year 2021)]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- Corporate and industry press describe the surviving collegiate-housing operations
  as continuing to be managed under the Greystar organization after closing, but no
  reputable-press source found during this review reports an audited financial
  scalar (revenue, net income, occupancy at the portfolio level, or similar) for the
  surviving business specifically within the ~2021-2023 window; any such figures
  would need independent primary-source verification before use. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the registrant terminated its Exchange Act reporting obligations within
  weeks of closing (Form 15 filed October 2, 2018), and because the one identified
  separately reporting joint-venture participant's fiscal-year-2021 Form 10-K does
  not present financial results specific to the relevant real estate, no public,
  audited 3-5-year outcome record for the collegiate-housing business is available
  through either avenue checked; the realized post-close record for this business
  is not observable in the public SEC record within the fixed outcome window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-039924, Form 15-12B] [SRC: SEC accession 0001662972-22-000027, Form 10-K]

[SLICE END]
